🔻 Iran’s Army chief warns of more severe, decisive response to enemy’s act of aggression

📌 Tehran, IRNA — Chief Commander of the Islamic Republic of Iran Army Major General Amir Hatami has emphasized the prominent role played by the air defense personnel in the recent US-Israeli-imposed wars, saying that any aggressor daring to violate the country’s sovereignty again will face even more severe consequences.

Visiting an exhibition showcasing the remains of enemy drones and missiles downed by the Army Air Defense Force on Thursday, Major General Hatami hailed the round-the-clock efforts of the force’s personnel, saying they have attained a new level of readiness from the past engagements.
​
He said that relying on advanced equipment and resources, the enemy sought to strangle Iran, but they failed to realize their objectives in the face of the solidarity, persistent effort, and dedication shown by the Iranian Armed Forces — particularly the air defense personnel.
​
Referring to some of the operational achievements on display, he said various types of enemy drones, missiles, and equipment that were intercepted or struck by air defense systems are merely a portion of the successes achieved by the air defense forces.
​
The exhibition demonstrates that Iran’s soldiers and combatants are always prepared to defend the country under any circumstances, he noted, adding that they are determined and better prepared than ever before.
​
Praising the Air Defense Force and its personnel for their dedication and sacrifices, Hatami warned that the enemies would face even more severe consequences should they make the mistake of committing an act of aggression again.

📡 Pezeshkian calls for strengthening Iran–KRG relations

📌 Tehran, IRNA — President Masoud Pezeshkian, highlighting the deep historical, cultural, and ethnic ties between the people of Iran and the Kurdistan Region of Iraq, has called for the strengthening of bilateral relations between the two sides across all sectors.

Pezeshkian exchanged views on the latest regional developments and ways to expand bilateral cooperation during a meeting with the President of Iraq’s Kurdistan Region, Nechirvan Barzani, on the sidelines of the 31st UN Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Turkiye, on Thursday.
​
The Iranian president stressed the need to leverage existing potential to elevate relations, especially in the economic and commercial domains, saying Iran stands fully prepared to achieve this objective.
​
Pointing to the advantages of friendly ties with other nations, Pezeshkian noted that enemies would fail to isolate the Iranian nation economically, given the support it enjoys from neighbors, such as the people of the Kurdistan Region.
​
He also referred to the illegal US-Israeli war of aggression amid pressures and sanctions, saying the enemies, despite their constant hostile actions, failed to weaken the resolve of the Iranian nation, which, he said, became more resilient by relying on domestic capabilities.
​
Barzani, for his part, expressed his pleasure at the meeting with his Iranian president and emphasized the necessity of establishing lasting peace and stability in the region.
​
Referring to the Kurdistan Region’s stance on the US-Israeli war, he said that it was clear from the first days of the outset of the war that aggressors would not only fail to achieve their objectives in Iran but would also exacerbate the complexity and difficulty of the regional situation.
​
We have consistently emphasized that neither do Iran’s leaders — unlike the leaders of certain other nations — yield to coercion, nor does the Iranian nation bow before oppression and pressure, he noted, adding that the Iraqi Kurdistan Region would not allow any anti-Iran actions to be carried out from its territory.
​
Barzani also expressed his readiness to expand economic and commercial relations with Iran, underscoring the necessity of leveraging existing potential to increase exchanges, boost trade, and strengthen economic cooperation between the two sides.
